summary: Standalone ORPO e2 adapter, greedy single-shot
hypothesis: An ORPO-trained adapter (epoch 2) should match or beat the SFT baseline on question quality, since ORPO's preference-alignment signal directly penalises rejected outputs and may sharpen judgment without a separate reward model.
technique: Single greedy on-device call using an ORPO epoch-2 fine-tuned adapter (adapterDirect topology), identical to the SFT baseline pipeline — only the adapter weights differ.
result: Scored 0.361 on the full-30 gate (1 win / 2 ties / 26 losses vs Sonnet), with specPass 100% and rubric scores atom=4, spec=4, cover=3, nat=4, nonRed=3. Coverage remained the weak dimension, and the result fell below the SFT baseline; the hypothesis was falsified and the adapter was discarded.
label: adapter_orpo_e2
